introHtml: Custom 3/4 sleeve shirts offer a polished yet relaxed silhouette that works well for team uniforms, trade shows, and casual office environments. The extended sleeve provides more coverage than a short sleeve while remaining cooler than a full long sleeve. Styles like the Ladies' Port Authority 3/4-Sleeve Tunic Blouse and the Men's Preston Long Sleeve Shirt (rolled) pair nicely with embroidery or screen printing for a clean, branded look.
